text:
Aisha (AE): kicking off Meridian Health deal thread. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM for ~15k users, RBAC group->role mapping, automated domain verification, and EU data residency. Need POC pricing and security SQ answer by end of week.
Carlos (SE): SAML: support IdP metadata import, certificate rollover, SP-initiated + IdP-initiated. Will send sample metadata and attribute mapping. SCIM v2 push supported; we flatten nested groups. For 15k users we recommend initial bulk + delta sync.
Priya (SRE): Hosted in eu-west-1 okay for EU residency. Dedicated gives VPC + KMS. Onboarding lead time: Hosted demo ~48h, Dedicated ~2 weeks for infra + legal if EU KMS. We'll need a maintenance window for initial bulk import.
Liam (Security): I'll run the SQ. Immediate gating items: DPA with EU addendum, encryption at rest keys in EU, and confirmation of access controls for logs. For SAML we require email, sub, and groups claims. SCIM must be over TLS; mTLS optional for private installs.
Aisha (AE): Pricing: they prefer committed 3-month if it reduces risk. Can we provide ballpark for Hosted vs Dedicated POC?
Carlos (SE): Ballparks: Hosted POC: support retainer $3k/mo + usage. Dedicated POC: reserved nodes (~2x A100 equiv) with commit ~ $22-26k/mo + one-time onboarding. Offer 3-month intro discount (15%). We can also propose a Hosted trial with $5k credit to encourage quick start.
Priya (SRE): Ops note: if they expect <24h sync window choose Dedicated. For Hosted demo we'll schedule bulk job off-peak. I'll also enable a temporary SCIM rate-limit increase for the POC.
Aisha (AE): Domain verification: they want automated proof for user email domains. Can we support automated MX/TXT flow or do we need manual verification?
Carlos (SE): We support automated TXT verification for domains tied to SAML/email claims. We'll provide step-by-step: add TXT with token, then we poll and mark domain verified. If they use 3rd-party management we can accept verification files.
Liam (Security): Legal: if they ask HIPAA/SOC2, that'll affect timeline. I'll add notes to SQ and flag any items requiring legal sign-off.
Aisha (AE): Action list: Carlos -> SAML/SCIM sample configs + attribute mappings (EOD tomorrow). Priya -> spin up eu-west demo + schedule bulk import (ETA 48h). Liam -> annotated SQ + DPA checklist (72h). I'll draft pricing options and follow up.
Carlos (SE): sample mapping snippet: ```{"groups_claim":"groups","role_map":{"meridian-admins":"admin","meridian-users":"user"}}``` will send full doc.
ops-bot: demo-hosted-eu build queued by Priya (SRE) -> job #318
Aisha (AE): Agree to keep SQ return by Fri. Any blockers? 
Carlos (SE): None from SE side.
Priya (SRE): No blockers; will post demo link in #secure-shared when ready.
Liam (Security): No blockers; legal may request extra time for DPA language.
Aisha (AE): Thanks team — I'll sync with Meridian after we have Carlos' config and the demo link. Keeping thread open for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
